March 16, 2018 - By Dolores Ford 
Sumitomo Life Insurance Company increased its stake in Trimble Inc Com (TRMB) by 60.68% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sumitomo Life Insurance Company bought 14,372 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.95% with the market. The institutional investor held 38,057 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.49 million, up from 23,685 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sumitomo Life Insurance Company who had been investing in Trimble Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.51 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.06 during the last trading session, reaching $38.29. About 536,129 shares traded. Trimble Inc. (NASDAQ:TRMB) has risen 51.45% since March 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 34.75% the S&P500. 
Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc increased its stake in Grupo Televisa Sa (TV) by 81.97% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc bought 5,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.76% with the market. The institutional investor held 11,100 shares of the broadcasting company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $273.84M, up from 6,100 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Paradigm Asset Management Co Llc who had been investing in Grupo Televisa Sa for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.35B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.56% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $15.84. About 1.12M shares traded. Grupo Televisa, S.A.B. (NYSE:TV) has declined 5.54% since March 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.24% the S&P500. 
Sumitomo Life Insurance Company, which manages about $785.08M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5,920 shares to 191,709 shares, valued at $29.55M in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Altria Group Inc Com (NYSE:MO) by 12,904 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 72,208 shares, and cut its stake in Teradyne Inc Com (NYSE:TER).
